direction: The completed (old) course must cover the content of the requested (new) course.
source: Project team setting. Thresholds and weights are editable here and should be confirmed with the department.

constraints.credit_hours_rule: The credit hours of the completed course must be equal to or greater than the requested UoS course.

transfer_credit_limits.community_college_note: Community college transfers are capped at 40 to 50 credit hours; the institution type is not in the database, so this is not checked automatically.

constraints.gpa_impact: Transferred credits appear as grade TR and do not count in the CGPA.
constraints.source: Course Equivalency Constraints document written by the team.
